text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I always buy clothes here, but... well... 
the sizes..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
! ...Hmm? By the way, do you have time 
after this?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That is so super cute, totally fab! 
Messiah-chan, don't you think it'd look 
great on you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
What a surprise... Even in shops meant for 
older women, there are clothes that I 
could actually wear.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real? They dropped new basketball 
shoes!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...To think they actually have it in this 
shop. My father told me it was out of 
stock everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Exploring every floor was definitely worth 
it. Thanks to that, I've opened up a whole 
new world.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That place just got renovated and has a 
ton of new shops, so why not check it out 
this week?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
!? My weight... is back to normal. 
However, I haven't done anything out of 
the ordinary—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-senpai... I understand everything 
now. This isn't about trailblazing, nor is 
it a breather. Your real objective is—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"So walking around the mall was for 
exercise, then. ...I am deeply impressed 
by your foresight."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A diet...?? Not really sure, but if 
it gets the vibes up, totally fine by me~.
